subject: Contract handoff play: sequencing, evidence checklist & sprint timeline
messages:
From: Emily Nguyen <emily@helixcare.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Contract handoff play: sequencing, evidence checklist & sprint timeline

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks for the call earlier — procurement & legal at HelixCare asked me to capture a clear MAP and an evidence checklist so we can align on sequencing for the MSA + DPA + Order Form. A few asks from our side to make the internal review straightforward: 

- Can you share a compact sequencing plan (gated milestones) with specific owners and expected days-to-sign for each artifact (MSA redline, DPA review, Order Form final)?
- We need the SOC 2 evidence list (logs retention, encryption at rest, access controls) mapped to the DPA/BAA timeline.
- Are you able to split signature — i.e., get the Order Form signed first to enable pilot, followed by DPA within 10 business days?

I attached the procurement questionnaire the legal team prefers. If you can send a MAP CSV or even a short checklist by EOD Friday we can route it through HelixCare legal and come back with any blocking items.

Thanks,
Emily
Procurement Lead, HelixCare
[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 58KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily@helixcare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract handoff play: sequencing, evidence checklist & sprint timeline

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the questionnaire. Draft plan below (high-level MAP + evidence handoff). I attached a redlined MSA (v3) and a short DPA summary to help legal triage.

Proposed sequencing (timeline = business days from MSA draft delivery to your legal team):
1) Day 0: Redwood sends MSA_draft_v3_redlined.pdf + DPA_summary.docx + MAP_quick_plan.csv (attached).
2) Day 0–3: HelixCare legal reads MSA redlines and flags top 3 repros (privacy, liability cap, data processing clauses).
3) Day 4–8: Joint redline sync (30–45 min) to triage items and agree on fallbacks.
4) Day 9–12: Redwood finalizes order form (pricing & pilot scope) and prepares DocuSign bundle.
5) Day 13: Execute Order Form (signature enable pilot environment).
6) Day 14–21: DPA finalization and SOC2 evidence handover.

Notes / controls:
- Split-signature path: we can accept Order Form signature to start a restricted pilot if HelixCare signs the Order Form and a written commitment to finish DPA within 10 business days.
- Owners: Mark (contracts) / Laura (security & evidence) / Rishi (customer success / rollout). See owners block below.
- Evidence: we included a short SOC2 matrix (see MAP_quick_plan.csv) with pointers to logs, retention policy, encryption keys, and audit contacts.

Owners & fast contacts:
- Contracts: markus_klein@redwood.com (Markus Klein) — primary for MSA redlines
- Security: laura_bennett@redwood.com (Laura Bennett) — SOC2 items & DPA mapping
- CS: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com (Rishi Malhotra) — pilot enablement & billing

Attachments referenced: [MSA_draft_v3_redlined.pdf], [DPA_summary.docx], [MAP_quick_plan.csv]

Next steps: 
- Laura & I will run a 30-min redline triage tomorrow (2028-09-03) at 11:00 PT (proposed). If that works, we will consolidate fallback language and produce the DocuSign bundle by Day 9.

Best,
Markus
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_draft_v3_redlined.pdf (pdf, 412KB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily@helixcare.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-03T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract handoff play: sequencing, evidence checklist & sprint timeline

Emily / Markus — thanks for the plan. I reviewed the MSA redline and DPA summary; quick notes inline and two asks from HelixCare security that will affect sequencing: 

- Data residency clause: HelixCare requires EU residency for patient identifiable data in production. We can accommodate via private deployment options, but that pushes the DPA finalization window by ~5 business days for the infra/ACL proofing.
- Evidence packaging: HelixCare needs a SOC2 evidence bundle that includes sample access logs, key rotation policy, and a short runbook for incident response. Laura recommends we prepare the bundle concurrently with the redlines so DPA review doesn't become a blocker.

Given those asks, my suggested adjusted timeline:
- Keep Order Form signature on Day 13 but mark the pilot as "staging-only" until DPA & residency confirmation (we'll gate production traffic).
- Move DPA finalization to Day 19 to allow infra validation for residency constraints.

I can take point on collecting the SOC2 evidence artifacts — I'll assemble an evidence packet and place it in the shared Drive folder today. If we do the 30-min triage now we can lock fallback language for the residency clause (two options: contractual warrant with engineering exception OR P2 private deployment addendum).

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_comments_inline.txt (txt, 6KB)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily@helixcare.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-04T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract handoff play: sequencing, evidence checklist & sprint timeline

All — quick confirmation from CS/ops side. We can support the split-signature approach. A couple of practical commitments from our side: 

- Canary plan: CS will enable a 3-week staging window post-Order Form signature limited to 5 concurrent users and no PHI in production until DPA & residency controls complete.
- Rollout owners: Rishi (CS) for pilot enablement, Laura (Security) for evidence handover, Markus (Contracts) for signature coordination.
- DocuSign bundle: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-sign (we will send the bundle by EOD 2028-09-04).

I'll create a short MAP_quick_plan.csv entry for HelixCare with owner names, dates, and a binary blocker flag so you can plug into your procurement tracker. Laura — can you confirm when the evidence folder is ready and share the Drive link?

Thanks — will keep the MAP live and update statuses as we move through the gates.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_quick_plan.csv (csv, 4KB)]
